name: Aldermark
description: A small, wounded kingdom of meadows, woods and water.

crag.name: Northern Crag
crag.description: Bare grey rock climbs into cloud. The wind here has a voice.

graveyard.name: Old Graveyard
graveyard.description: Leaning headstones and a chill that has nothing to do with the weather.

falls.name: Falls Ledge
falls.description: A thin waterfall drops into a pool of impossibly clear water. Something glimmers behind the spray.

tower_approach.name: Tower Approach
tower_approach.description: A cracked causeway leads north to a tower of black stone, its door sealed by a seam of light.

north.failure_message: The seam of light holds the door shut. Only the Triad, made whole, could open it.

whispering_wood.name: Whispering Wood
whispering_wood.description: Tall trees close overhead. A great hollow oak sits at the heart of the clearing, its trunk split like a doorway.

crossroads.name: Crossroads
crossroads.description: Four worn paths meet at a milestone so weathered it names nowhere at all.

reed_marsh.name: Reed Marsh
reed_marsh.description: Reeds hiss in the wind and the ground gives underfoot.

lakeshore.name: Lakeshore Trail
lakeshore.description: A trail follows the shore of a wide, flat lake.

glade.name: Sunlit Glade
glade.description: A quiet glade, warm and full of bees.

village_green.name: Village Green
village_green.description: A handful of cottages around a green. A well, a bench, and a sense of holding breath.

old_bridge.name: Old Bridge
old_bridge.description: A humpbacked stone bridge over a slow stream.

lake_dock.name: Lake Dock
lake_dock.description: A rotted jetty juts into the lake. Far out, a low island shows through the mist.

east.failure_message: The island is a long swim through cold water. You need something that floats.

hermit_hill.name: Hermit's Hill
hermit_hill.description: A grassy hill with a cave mouth in its flank, a thread of smoke rising from inside.

starting_meadow.name: Starting Meadow
starting_meadow.description: A meadow of long grass. Paths lead north, east and up the hill to the west.

market_lane.name: Market Lane
market_lane.description: A lane of shuttered stalls. One stall is open, and it is dug into the hillside.

east_dunes.name: East Dunes
east_dunes.description: Low dunes of pale sand roll toward a horizon that never arrives.
